proposedPolicies.rule: Both existing reviewers explicitly chose the same exact unchanged scientific question card, verified against the original proposal definition; the chosen target has an agreed addresses/instantiates/specializes role. Global source-context checks find no competing explicit home, compound coverage ambiguity or unresolved same-target premise/annotation conflict. Extra method/comparison roles do not veto the home. The target must have a separate scope admission before compilation.

When A does not settle the home, both existing reviewers place the complete source unit as member in the same unchanged scientific broad scope; the source has one such unflagged broad destination, no unresolved premise/annotation conflict and no inherited/context ambiguity in those member notes. Admit that whole-family organizational home, including compound source questions whose subtargets remain within the reviewed family. Keep all exact source text and typed subtarget contributions. Do not declare a compound source one atomic canonical question or split mass merely because it has several targets.

exceptions: Existing 1,055 home approvals and the five exact KK/UHECR source homes are preserved. Their six KK/UHECR rows include the explicit half/half compound allocation; no competing source mass is added.
Overlap-only rows need whole-question coverage or explicitly approved normalized overlaps; they do not inherit weight 1 by this policy.
Several distinct broad or fine homes require canonical reconciliation or an explicit choice. Common-target grouping is not equivalence, and no ancestor plus descendant receive duplicate direct mass.

Annotation-only flags are not scientific rejection. Exact admitted repairs are already applied; unresolved severed notes or premise-dependent wording stay a concrete bounded decision rather than triggering blanket paper rereading.
A contextual or inherited positive role does not justify a home: the linear KK source keeps its admitted linear-cosmology home and receives no production allocation.

All pending rows remain outside accepted H until explicit coordinator policy and exact scope/row bindings are recorded. The 43 reserved sources remain unallocated until the separate post-test amendment.
remainingDecisionWorkflow: Resolve each listed exact scientific choice using its complete source description, existing paired notes and already reviewed scope definitions. Inspect new primary text only when those records leave a material premise or scope ambiguity. Reuse retained meaningful broader scopes instead of forcing the narrowest home; create no generic fallback.
